{{Quote|Well, he’s an idiot. But sharing some kitchen duty with you two might smarten you all up. All right, you can get your unauthorized gear. First, let’s finish this.|Imperial officer about Balawan|<ref name="IF" />}}
'''Balawan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer stationed on [[Victory Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. As the Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] pushed into the base, [[Wraith Squadron]] pilot [[Garik Loran]] used Balawan as an excuse to explain the presence of a bag. He did this by asserting that Balawan had allowed him to carry the bag, which the superior accepted, as he also had no high opinion of Balawan.<ref name="IF" />
